svg.title: Trots Oudtshoorn sand heritage T-shirt back
svg.desc: Circular feather, sunrise and mountain back print with Rooted Here Proudly Local slogan. Intended garment colour: sand beige. Transparent background. All lettering is vector geometry; no fonts or linked images.
